Welcome to Das Himmel Haus!

Here is everything you need for your stay with us, from planning your time prior to departure to the Shanty Creek area, all the way through checkout. In this easy-to-navigate link, you will find information about the cabin, ideas of things to do in the area, our Wi-Fi login credentials, and so much more.

In order to best enjoy your time in our home, we encourage you to add this "app" to your phone. All of the content will even be accessible when your phone is offline.

* It's not really an "app", but more a tool for easy access on your home screen

  • For iPhone:
    • Tap the square with arrow pointing up at the bottom of your screen
    • Select "Add to Home Screen"
  • For Android:
    • Tap "Add to Home Screen" where prompted when first accessing the site

Print or Save a PDF
If you would like to print certain pages ahead of traveling, or if you'd like to save a PDF to your device, just tap the print button above. It won't print right away, but will create a PDF which you can save or print.

Contacting Us
We pride ourselves on swiftly meeting guest needs. We can be reached as follows:

  • Preferred: Airbnb or VRBO message
  • Phone: 404-358-1552 (emergencies)
  • Instagram: @Bk_stays
  • Facebook: BK Stays

What Next?
Please relax, unwind, have fun, and enjoy your stay!

We sincerely love Bellaire, Shanty Creek, and Schuss Mountain, and are excited to share them all with you! The rolling hills and stunning fall colors make this area feel like a postcard come to life. Summers are all about fun in the sun—swimming, fishing, boating, and every kind of water activity you can think of. We’re lucky to be close to the cozy little ski resort for winter adventures and surrounded by some great golf courses for those who love to hit the greens. You've chosen the perfect spot to enjoy the best of every season, and we can’t wait for you to experience it too.

We could post turn-by-turn directions here.

OR - you could just use Waze or Google Maps.

Either option will get you to the home ;)

Address: 6004 Heideldorf Lane - Bellaire Michigan, 49615

The Access Code for the front door is

1552

To lock the door, simply press the lock button. Please make sure all external doors are locked whenever you leave.

* If for some reason the code doesn't work please call me at 404-358-1552. I will get you the lockbox code for the spare key!

Standard check-out is at 10:00 AM on your departure date (Unless you've paid for a late check-out). 

When you've finished your stay, technically, you can just leave no questions asked lol :) But, if you really wanted to give our cleaning team some love, we would appreciate it if you would take care of a few simple things:

  • Dishwasher - Load and start the dishwasher
  • Jacuzzi - Close and lock the lid 
  • Sauna - Close and lock the door
  • Towels - Place all used towels in the shower
  • Trash - Bag/secure all loose trash and place in 2 GFL bins (Black Bin with Green Lid) 
  • Lock Up - Lock all doors

We hope you guys had an amazing stay! Thank you again and safe travels back home.

The service is provided for your enjoyment but you are responsible for safe and appropriate use and complying with all laws. If there is any loss of service please contact us.

Please Read Before Use - See Photos Below.

The LEFT dial is the temperature - Min to Max etc. Leave the dial just slightly under MAX- don't crank it to full MAX.

The RIGHT dial is the timer. Each number is for 1 hour, 2 hours, 3 hours, 4 hours etc.

Do Not Turn Past The "First" 1

  • If you go straight to the "second 1", 2, or 3 or more) or the heater WILL NOT start until 2/3 hours).
  • That is a Delayed Start Setting ie. 1-2-3 hours later etc. 

Simply turn the dial to the first (1) and the heater will run on MAX for (1) Hour.

Put the Left Dial Just Under Max, and Select 1 Hour on the Right Dial.

Keep it Simple :)

There is a propane grill for your personal use on the back patio. Please follow the grill instructions carefully when using propane. Do not forget to close the valve when you're done!

We always try to keep a full tank on site - but sometimes they run out before before we can get a replacement there. If you run out and need a replacement, we can try and get you a replacement delivered - but - depending on timing - it may be faster for you to run and exchange the empty.

Of course we will reimburse you for the tank and your time!

FIREPLACE HELP VIDEO

If you’d like to use the fireplace and need a little assistance, please check out the troubleshooting video below. It walks you through everything you need:

• How to turn on the fireplace with a simple press of a button
• How to relight the pilot light, step by step, if needed

If the pilot light is already lit, all you need to do is press the on/off switch located on the left side of the gas log set. The video will show you exactly where this switch is and how to operate it.

Let us know if you need anything at all!

PLEASE READ BEFORE USING! 

Jacuzzi Quick Start Guide

Jets (Pump 1)
• Press 1x for low. 2x for high. 3x to turn off

Light
• Press Light to turn On or Off
• Do Not Hold the Light Button (enters programming mode)

Temperature
• Press ▲ or ▼ to adjust temperature
• Setting saves automatically after a moment

Air Bubbles
• Turn air knobs on the tub rim to adjust bubbles
• Open = more bubbles
• Closed = fewer bubbles

Important Notes
• Do not hold the Light button or attempt to access programming menus
• Do not press buttons repeatedly or rapidly
• Do not lean, sit, or push on the control panel
• Do not force air knobs or diverters past their stopping point
